stories.headline: What are ‘space weapons’, which US says it has deployed into orbit?
stories.description: The rare announcement from Washington is expected to raise alarm among allies and adversaries alike, experts say.

stories.headline: Bangladesh hands death sentences to 7 aides of ousted Prime Minister Hasina
stories.description: Seven members of ousted PM Sheikh Hasina’s Awami League convicted of crimes including murder, provoking killings.

stories.headline: South Korea embraces Central Asian leaders, looking to boost regional clout
stories.description: Seoul is set to host its first presidential meeting with five Russia-allied states positioning themselves as a bloc.

stories.headline: Coalition talks likely as no party dominates Philippines’ Bangsamoro region
stories.description: With 98.56 percent of party-list votes counted, no party has received a majority, according to unofficial results.

stories.headline: Key findings from Lucy Letby Thirlwall Inquiry
stories.description: The inquiry found a "complete failure to protect babies on the neonatal unit" where the nurse worked.
